name: hunt_route
purpose: Pick the next allowlisted witness question during a hunt. Can only choose from the allowlisted questions, or hand the hunt to the LLM when unsure.
state_template: HUNT LOG SO FAR: <investigation goal, questions already asked, condensed answers, open hypothesis>.

next_question.instructions: Given the evidence gathered so far, which witness question should the observatory ask next?

criteria.attest: Confirm the witness is alive, journald/auth.log reachable, and not blind
criteria.sketch: Auth failures, new sudoers, new services or timers
criteria.escalate_to_llm: Evidence is ambiguous, novel, or the path is unclear — let the LLM reason about the hunt
